{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Select only the two variables of interest and drop rows with missing values in either
subset = df[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].dropna()

# Compute the Pearson correlation
corr = subset['flipper_length_mm'].corr(subset['body_mass_g'])

# Print the result
print(corr)"}
